summary: Town of Fallsburg pages confirm the phone (845-434-5877) and camping, bath house, pool, boat docks and rowboats at Morningside Park. The only camping price the town posts is its 2023 fee sheet ('RV & Tent sites (Fallsburg residents only) - $40/night'), too old to record and residents-only. No page states hookups, site count, lengths, season or booking, so nothing written.
flags: CRITERIA: the Town of Fallsburg's own camping fee sheet (https://www.fallsburgny.gov/DocumentCenter/View/1567/Morningside-Park-Camping-fees-2023, created 2023-08-16, the newest the town posts) says 'RV & Tent sites (Fallsburg residents only) - $40/night'. The entry's note and inclusion_evidence say 'Open to public'. Unless the town has opened it since, a non-resident cannot camp here. The town also posts a 'Seasonal Camping Rental Contract Parks 2020'. A ParkAdvisor review (Oct 2022) reports a caller being told camping had ended; unverified. Worth a call to 845-434-5877 before keeping it.
Website: the stored link is the town's thin facility listing; the town's Parks & Camping page with the fee sheet, park map and rental forms is https://www.fallsburgny.gov/198/Parks-Camping.
